Rule pack — missingness and completeness

make_rule_pack_missingness.Rd

Builds executable FlagRule objects for the missingness and completeness checks from the core observability rule catalog.

Usage

make_rule_pack_missingness(
  domain,
  key_vars,
  required_vars = character(),
  subject_var = "USUBJID",
  site_var = "SITEID",
  visit_var = NULL,
  baseline_flag_var = NULL,
  missingness_threshold = 0.1,
  owner_team = "DM",
  ...
)

Arguments

domain

Domain name targeted by the rules.

key_vars

Character vector of key variables.

required_vars

Character vector of variables that must be present and non-missing in every record (R024).

subject_var

Subject identifier variable. Default "USUBJID".

site_var

Site identifier variable. Default "SITEID".

visit_var

Optional variable that identifies visit or timepoint (used by R023).

baseline_flag_var

Variable whose value "Y" marks the baseline record for a subject (used by R026 and R027). Typically "ABLFL" or "DTYPE".

missingness_threshold

Numeric [0, 1]. Variables with a missing rate above this threshold are flagged by R021–R023. Default 0.1.

owner_team

Team assigned to follow up on flagged records.

Value

A list of FlagRule objects compatible with run_flags().

Details

Rule IDNameScope
R021Overall missingness spikeSnapshot
R022Missingness spike by siteGroup
R023Missingness spike by visit/timepointGroup
R024Required variable missingness > 0Snapshot
R025Expected domain emptySnapshot
R026Subjects without follow-up after baselineGroup
R027New subjects missing baseline assessmentsGroup

Examples

pack <- make_rule_pack_missingness(
  domain        = "ADVS",
  key_vars      = c("USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVISIT"),
  required_vars = c("USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVAL"),
  baseline_flag_var = "ABLFL"
)
length(pack)
#> [1] 7
